title.zh: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act
title.en: US Senate fails to advance CLARITY Act

current_state.zh: The US Senate failed to advance a cloture motion on the CLARITY Act by a 49-50 vote, falling short of the 60 needed and likely stalling the first comprehensive federal crypto market-structure framework for the remainder of the year.
current_state.en: The US Senate failed to advance a cloture motion on the CLARITY Act by a 49-50 vote, falling short of the 60 needed and likely stalling the first comprehensive federal crypto market-structure framework for the remainder of the year.
